# dsh-mobile-pwa

> Complete mobile PWA for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): pairing-code + device-token gateway for public-internet access behind your own reverse proxy + install-to-homescreen + offline + touch gestures + real Web Push agent-done notifications.

## Key facts
- Repo: KyoMio/dsh-mobile-pwa. MIT license, `dsh-plugin` topic. Derivative of `dsh-mobile-gate` (MIT).
- Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:KyoMio/dsh-mobile-pwa#rework/public-auth-push` (or `./dsh-mobile-pwa` for a local checkout).
- Architecture: standalone child-process Node gateway (Node stdlib + one runtime dep, `web-push`), listens on `127.0.0.1:3088` by default, sits behind a user-run TLS-terminating reverse proxy (nginx/Caddy). Device identity = pairing token (cookie `lg_device`), not source IP. Reverse-proxies paired devices to DSH on 127.0.0.1:3080; DSH webserver untouched (still 127.0.0.1-only). HTML injection adds PWA manifest link, service-worker bootstrap, touch CSS, randomUUID polyfill.
- Gateway serves `/pwa/*` assets (manifest, sw.js, app.css, icons, offline.html) + `/pwa/push/*` (real Web Push: VAPID + aes128gcm agent-done notifications).
- Env: `LAN_GATE_PORT` (3088), `LAN_GATE_HOST` (127.0.0.1), `LAN_GATE_TARGET_PORT` (3080), `LAN_GATE_RATE_LIMIT` (120), `LAN_GATE_TRUSTED_PROXIES` (comma-separated IPs, for proxies not on loopback), `LAN_GATE_VAPID_SUBJECT` (mailto:admin@localhost).
- Admin (local-direct-connection only, 403 otherwise): http://127.0.0.1:<port>/lan-gate/admin — generate pairing codes, rename/set-kind/revoke devices, revoke-all, trigger a push.
- Security: 8-char one-time pairing code (10 min TTL), 5-wrong-code lockout (15 min), revocable per-device tokens, 120 req/min per resolved client IP, admin surface rejects any request carrying `X-Forwarded-*` headers.
